name: Tobub Browser Automation
description: Use a local Tobub Runtime to run, inspect, compose, and create reusable browser automation Skills.
description_zh: 通过本机 Tobub Runtime 发现、运行、组合和创建浏览器自动化 Skill。
description_en: Run, inspect, compose, and create reusable browser automation Skills through your local Tobub Runtime.
examples_zh: 抓取今天 GitHub Trending 的 JavaScript 项目，并按星标数整理。
采集这个区域的咖啡馆名称、地址和评分，保存为结构化结果。
检查我已安装的 Tobub Skills，推荐适合监控 Reddit 新帖的流程。
examples_en: Collect today's trending JavaScript repositories on GitHub and sort them by stars.
Collect cafe names, addresses, and ratings in this area as structured data.
Inspect my installed Tobub Skills and recommend a workflow for monitoring new Reddit posts.
